channel.title: Vidlark blog
channel.description: Guides, tutorials and comparisons for recording YouTube videos with your camera, mic and screen on a Mac or Windows PC, with Vidlark, the free recorder.

item.title: How to use your phone as a webcam on a Mac, free
item.description: Use any iPhone or Android phone as a webcam on a Mac, free, over Wi-Fi with no app to install and no cable. Film up to four angles at once with Vidlark.

item.title: How to record your camera and screen as separate files
item.description: Record your camera and screen separately in one take, free on Mac and Windows. See every file Vidlark saves, where it goes and how the files stay in sync.
